model: Same three-level ladder, signal b*cos(pi*t), tau=1, n=64, tp=0.25, eta=1. Real finite analysis pulses use the SAME coupled Hamiltonian, detuning and amplitude errors as sensing pulses. All nuisance values are conditioned on; joint nuisance estimation is NOT claimed.
input_preparation: ideal |+x>; fixed overhead includes preparation/readout time but no measured preparation fidelity is claimed

readout.pulse_placement: centered in common analysis window; idle on both sides, including Z+
readout.native_observable: click effect p_dark*I+(p_bright-p_dark)*|0><0|; no event discarded
readout.shot_allocation: equal one sixth of total shots per setting; retain setting identity; average FI, never sum six independent budgets

noise.meaning: isotropic qutrit depolarization during total sensing+analysis time, rho -> exp(-0.2)*rho+(1-exp(-0.2))*I/3; commutes with any coherent evolution
noise.hardware_calibration: none; optical probabilities and all noise parameters are explicit synthetic assumptions

randomized_baseline.method: global phase uniform [0,2*pi) per XY8 block, fixed PCG64 generators seed_base+i, i=0..31
randomized_baseline.score: equal shot average of conditional FI with phase-realization identity retained, same six-setting readout and time cost

gates.known_blind_spots: all 8 archived v1 roots give v2 FI rate >= 1 percent of ideal CP with the same detector, noise and analysis budget
gates.preliminary_advantage: minimum v2 candidate FI rate >= 2*largest baseline minimum AND candidate median >= 0.9*largest baseline median; includes RXY8, excludes raw_RS ablation
gates.continuous_detuning: conditional interpolation lower bound >0 across [12,16] for EACH of nine fixed error pairs; not a certificate over continuous amplitude/detuning errors
gates.scientific_novelty: unknown; Pauli readout, erasure sensing, random phases and RS polynomials are known

continuous_audit.method: adaptive linear interpolation of six click-probability derivatives; analytic norm-curvature bound, no extrapolation from a positive scalar FI grid
continuous_audit.arithmetic_status: conditional on declared endpoint numerical-error allowance; NOT an interval-arithmetic proof

dephasing_stress.cases: all 8 archived roots plus cycles [12,12.125,12.25,13,14,15,16] for amplitude errors [-0.02,0,0.02] and zero qubit detuning
dephasing_stress.lindblad_operator: sqrt(gamma/2)*diag(1,-1,0); replaces isotropic depolarization, retains optical noise
dephasing_stress.interpretation: distinct noise-model stress, not a device-calibrated model or continuous dephasing guarantee

execution: NumPy only; no optimizer, paid endpoints, hardware, external messages or publishing. Preserve all old evidence, freeze this source before numerical tests.
